title: Teen Tries Kidnapping Bikini Barista in Coffee Shop Drive-Thru: Cops
description:
A teenager’s alleged abduction attempt at a Bikini-Barista business in Lakewood, Washington, was caught on camera in a shocking clip. Police took Ezekiel Guerrero, 19, into custody after the disturbing surveillance video allegedly showed him trying to yank a bikini-clad barista through the drive-through window around 2 a.m. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
